lead_raw_text:
The structure of Er₂In₄Si₄ (Er(InSi)₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 16-atom unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows In centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 In, 6 Si) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, Er centers with 16 neighbors (8 In, 8 Si), and Si centers with 9 neighbors (4 Er, 4 In, 1 Si). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between In 12-vertex and Si 9-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing between Er 16-vertex and In 12-vertex polyhedra.
